<span id="d02-record"></span>

The sprout-height results can add a developmental perspective to the regeneration
basal-area evidence. Once those results are accepted, we'll connect them to
light, retention, and cohort development in a 1–1.5-page subsection. We'll consider
combining it with D01 if the two results lead to one inseparable management message.

The [initial RD03 interpretation review](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-interpretation)
explains why height of selected clump maxima does not establish recruitment,
physiological shade tolerance, or a long-term overstory-retention threshold.
It also distinguishes leading-sprout replacement from growth of the same stem.
We'll retain those limits when interpreting the eventual accepted model and
displays; the current review does not supply accepted publication results.

The [RD03 Phase Three analysis](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-phase-three-analysis) now
supplies bootstrap contrasts and a joint-height sensitivity for the recorded
cohort. Discussion must follow the verified distinction between attained height,
within-treatment slowing, and differences in slowing between treatments. Review
the numerical and distributional limitations before interpreting the display
proposals, which still await acceptance. The residual-tree association remains
exploratory and does not establish a causal effect or its absence. Original
enrollment and mortality history remain unavailable; interpretation cannot
extend to survival or area-wide recruitment.
